evolution.missing_field_semantics: Absent optional fields are null; unknown fields pass through

alive.description: One per PID running the Hermes launcher or Python hermes_cli.main entry; not turns, chats, threads or cleanup helpers

observed_at.description: UTC time of the /proc observation, unchanged during the three-second monotonic TTL

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
